lines.1: 「Crab, seriously. Don't you think Leo puts people at ease when he talks to them?」
lines.2: 「Yeah. With someone like her, I think the safest bet is for Leo to go alone.」
lines.3: 「You heard them. We're counting on you.」
lines.4: 「You expect me to persuade someone like that?」
lines.6: 「Idiot, don't you want to impress the Princess?」
lines.8: 「Then it's simple. Recruit that girl and the Princess will be happy.」
lines.11: 「That's our Leo! What a man! Mwah!」
lines.12: 「Okay, the blown kiss is never happening, but she might squeeze your hand!」
lines.13: 「Her hand, huh...? That does sound nice.」
lines.14: 「Then go! Bring home the glory! And just so we're clear, this has nothing to do with me wanting an easy ride, okay?」
lines.17: For some reason, he sounded delighted about it.
lines.18: Recruiting one younger girl ought to be easy enough.
